# Packet — popol-vuh-002: The animals, and the people of mud (fols. 2v–4r)

The established text (pinned) follows, one paragraph per block. A unit's `t` is cut from it by script (a sentence, or a long sentence or litany cut at a syntactic joint; couplets never split).

¶1
Ta xqui nohih chic vchicopil huyub, chahal re quichelah ronohel; vvinaquil huyub ri: quieh, ꜯiquin, ꜭoh, balam, cumaꜩ, zochoh, canti, chahal caam.

¶2
Cacha ri Alom, Ꜭaholom: “Xa pa chi lolinic, ma xa on chi ꜯininic vxe che, caam? Cate vꜩ chi ꜭohe chahal re,” xeꜭha cut, ta xqui nohih, xqui ꜩihoh puch. Huzu cu xvinaquir queh, ꜯiquin. Ta xqui zipah cut rochoch queh, ꜯiquin: “At, queh, pa be yaa, pa ziuan cat var vi; varal cat ꜭohe vi pa quim, pa zacal, pa quechelah; qui poco vi ivib, cahcah ibinibal, ychacabal.” Chuxic, xe vchaxic.

¶3
Ta xqui chi cut cochoch chuti ꜯiquin, nima ꜯiquin: “Ix, ix ꜯiquin, chuvi che, chuvi caam quix ochochin vi, quix hain vi; chiri quix poc vi, quix quiritah vi chuꜫab che, chuꜫab caam,” xe vꜭhaxic quieh, ꜯiquin. Ta xqui bano qui banoh; ronohel xu camo vvarabal, vyacalibal. Quehe cut cochoch vi chicop ri vleu xu yao Alom, Ꜭaholom. Xuꜩininaca chic ronohel ri queh, ꜯiquin.

¶4
Ta xe vꜭhax chi cut ry queh, ꜯiquin rumal Ꜯacol, Bitol, Alom, Ꜭaholom: “Quix ꜭhauoc, quix ziquinoc; mix yonoloquinic, mix ziquinic; quix ꜭhavahe tah chi huhunal, chu hutac chobil, chi hutac molahil,” xe vꜭhaxic ri queh, ꜯiquin, ꜭoh, balam, cumaꜩ. “Chi byih na cut ri cabi, coh icaharizah, oh ichuch, oh icahau. Quiꜭhava na cut Huracan, Chipi Caculha, Raxa Caculha, Vꜭux Cah, Vꜭux Vleuh, Ꜯacol, Bitol, Alom, Ꜭaholom; quix ꜭhaoc, coh iziquih, coh iꜫihila,” xe vꜭhaxic.

¶5
Ma cu xuꜩinic xeꜭhauic quehe ta ri vinac; xa que vachelahic, xa que caralahic, xa que vohonic; mavi xvachinic vvach qui ꜭhabal; halahoh xcoꜫibeh chi qui huhunal.

¶6
Ta xqui ta ri Ꜯacol, Bitol mavi mixuꜩinic, mixeꜭhauic; xeꜭha chic chi quibil quib: “Mavi mixuꜩin vbixic cabi rumal, oh cahꜯac, oh pu cahbit. Mavi vꜩ,” xꜭha chic chi quibil quib ri Alom, Ꜭaholom.

¶7
Xe vꜭhax cut: “Xa quix halatahic, rumal mavi mixuꜩinic, mavi mixix ꜭhauic. Mi cu xca hal caꜩih: ivecha, icuxun, ivarabal, iyacalibal xivech vi; mixe vuxic ziuan, quechelah, rumal mavi xuꜩin caꜫihiloxic; mavi ix ziquiy. Que ca ꜭo, co vi lo ꜫihilonel, nimanel; chi ca ban chic. Xa chi cam ipatan; xa itiohil chi cachic; ta chuxoc. Are cut chi patanih,” xe vꜭhaxic, ta xe pixabaxic chuti chicop, nima chicop ꜭo chuvach vleu.

¶8
Ta xrah cu qui tih chic qui ꜫih; xrah qui tihtobeh chic; xrah pu qui nuc chic ꜫihilabal. Xma xqui ta vi qui ꜭhabal chi quibil quib; xma xnauachir vi cut, xma xbanatah vi puch. Quehe cut xe chacatah vi qui tiohil; xqui patanih; xe tiyic, xe camizaxic ri chicop ꜭo varal chuvach vleuh.

¶9
Quehe cut vtihtobexic chic vinac ꜯac, vinac bit cumal Ꜯacol, Bitol, Alom, Ꜭaholom: “Xa cu tiha chic! Mix yopih ravaxic, vzaquiric; ca bana ꜩucul que, cool que. Hupacha ta coh ziquixoc, ta coh nabax puch chuvach vleuh? Mix ca tiho chirech ri nabe caꜯac, cabit; mavi mixuꜩinic caꜫihiloxic, cacalaixic puch cumal. Quehe cut ca tiha vi vbanic ahnim, ahxob, ꜩucul, cool,” xeꜭha.

¶10
Ta vꜯaquic cut, vbanic puch: vleu, xocol vtiohil xqui bano. Ma cu vꜩ xqui lo: xa chi yohomanic, xa ꜩubulic, xa nebelic, xa lubanic, xa vvlanic, xa pu chiumaric; mavi chi colol vholom; xa hum benac vi vvach; xa culuvach, mavi chi mucun chirih. Chi chau nabec, mahabi vnaoh; xa huzuc chiumar pa ha; mavi ꜭo.

¶11
Xeꜭha chi cu ri Ahꜯac, Ahbit: “Cauach labec ta chuxoc, xa labe mavi chi binic, ma pu chi pocotahic. Ta chuxoc xa vnaoh chiri,” xecha. Ta xqui yoh cut, xqui yoc chic ri qui ꜯac, qui bit. Xeꜭha chi cut: “Hupacha qui chi ca bano chuꜩin ta vi, chi nauachir ta vi ꜫihiloy quech, ziquiy quech?” xecha, ta xqui naohih chic: “Xa ca byih chique Xpiyacoc, Xmucane, Hunahpu Vuch, Hunahpu Vtiu: Qui tiha chic vꜫihixic, vbitaxic.” Xe vꜭhan qui quib Ahꜯac, Ahbit. Ta xqui byih cut chire Xpiyacoc, Xmucane.

¶12
Cate cut vbixic ri chiquech ri e nicvachinel, Ratit Ꜫih, Ratit Zac, que vꜭhaxic cumal ri Ꜯacol, Bitol; are qui bi ri Xpiyacoc, Xmucane.

¶13
Xeꜭha cu ri Huracan ruꜭ Tepeu, Ꜫucumaꜩ, ta xqui byih chirech ahꜫih, ahbit, e nicvachinel: “Xuculu; xa pu chu rico, cheta chic chi cavinac bitoh, chi cavinac ꜯacoh, ta chic ꜩucul, cool, coh ziquixtah, coh nabaxtah puch. Catoc ta cut pa ꜩih, Iyom, Mamom, catit, camam, Xpiyacoc, Xmucane; cha tah ta chauaxoc, ta zaquiroc, caziquixic, catoquexic, canabaxic rumal vinac ꜯac, vinac bit, vinac poy, vinac anom. Cha ta chuxoc.”

## Establishment log (doubtful readings, letters chosen, supralinear words — the notes must say so)

# Establishment log — popol-vuh-002 (images 0012–0014, end of sentence from 0015)

Read 2026-11-23 from source/pages/i0012–i0015 in strips at full resolution, checked word by word against
Brasseur 1861 (OCR lines 18470–18760 and following). Start: `Ta xqui nohih chic vchicopil huyub` (0012,
line 2). End: `Cha ta chuxoc.` (0015, line 3), where Brasseur begins a new paragraph (`Ch'y qutun y bi`);
the speech of Huracan to the grandparents goes on in popol-vuh-003.

## Letter rule used (from the pilot's practice)
- q-shaped letter where Brasseur has g → ꜫ, u dropped (as the pilot's `vꜫihilabal` for MS `vquihilabal`):
  `iꜫihila`, `caꜫihiloxic` (×2), `ꜫihilonel`, `qui ꜫih`, `ꜫihilabal`, `ꜫihiloy`, `vꜫihixic`, `Ratit Ꜫih`, `ahꜫih`, `xcoꜫibeh`.
- q-shaped letter where Brasseur has q (=ꜭ) → kept qu, as the pilot's `quichelah`: `quichelah`, `quechelah`.
  (Brasseur has `gichelah` at the first; the pilot's spelling of the same word was followed.)
- g-shaped letter → ꜭ (`ꜭoh`, `ꜭo`, `ꜭohe`, `Ꜭaholom`, `ruꜭ`); `gh` → ꜭh (`xeꜭha`, `xe vꜭhaxic`, `ꜭhabal`, `quix ꜭhauoc`).
- plain c kept where Brasseur has q or g: `canti` (B. qanti), `cate` (B. qate), `ychacabal` (B. chakabal),
  `xu camo` (B. x-u gamo; the c has a small hook, possibly ꜫ — kept c), `icaharizah` (B. gaharizah),
  `co vi lo` (B. qo-vi lo), `qui nuc` (B. nuq), `Cate cut` (B. Qatecut).
- The ꜩ-type ligature (ß-like) stands in this hand for tz, tz' and also ti: read `ti` where Brasseur has
  ti (`Xa cu tiha chic`, `Mix ca tiho`, `ca tiha vi`, `vtiohil`, `vtihtobexic`, `Hunahpu Vtiu`, `Qui tiha chic`);
  ꜯ in tz' words (`ꜯiquin`, `ꜯininic` as the pilot's `caꜯininic`, `ꜯac`, `vꜯaquic`); ꜩ otherwise.
- The t written like an h with a loop (as in `chuti`) read t: `Ratit` ×2, `catit` (B. r'atit, k'atit).

## Doubtful readings
- `xe tiyic` (0013): the MS has the ti-ligature followed by `yc` or `iyc`; Brasseur's OCR is lost here. His
  French ("réduits à être mangés") gives the sense; read `tiyic`. Uncertain.
- `xa ꜩubulic` (0014): ß-ligature; Brasseur's OCR lost. tz or tz' undecided; printed ꜩ (the default).
- `mix yonoloquinic` (0012): an ink blot between `yonolo` and `quinic`, with a stroke above it like an i-dot;
  Brasseur `yonoliquinic`. Printed the visible letters.
- `Chi byih` (0012) and `Xa ca byih` (0014): the MS letters look like `byyh`; Brasseur `biyh` and `byih`.
  Printed `byih` both times.
- `Xuculu` (0014): MS `xuculu`; Brasseur `X-a culu`. Printed as written, one word, meaning uncertain.
- `Xeꜭha cu ri Huracan` (0014): MS `qu ri`; Brasseur `cu ri`. Printed cu.
- `vvlanic` (0014): MS `xavvlanic`, Brasseur `xav'ulanic`. Printed `xa vvlanic` as written.

## Letters shared across a word boundary
Ximénez writes one c where a word ending in c meets cu/cut. Printed the letters as written and divided
after them: `Huzu cu` (MS `huzucu`; B. `huzu cu`; the pilot has the word `huzuc`), `xqui chi cut` (MS
`xquichicut`; B. `x-quichic cut`), `xe vꜭhax chi cut` (MS `chicut`; B. `chicut`). The drafter should
note the likely `huzuc cu` / `chic cut`.

## Supralinear and corrections
- `chi huhunal` (0012): `hu` written above the line between `hu` and `nal`; printed in place.
- `Hupacha qui chi ca bano` (0014): after line-final `qui-`, the next line opens with a struck-out `qu`.
  The `qui` was not struck and is printed; Brasseur omits it (`Hupacha chi ka bano`). It may be a slip.
- A blot before `vbanic puch` (0014) is a correction; nothing legible under it.
- A paragraph sign (large blot / ¶) before `Cate cut vbixic` (0014): paragraph begun there.

## Word order and Brasseur differences, image followed
- `pa zacal` (B. zacul), `pa be yaa`, `ivib` (B. yvib), `ibinibal` (B. y binibal), `quieh, ꜯiquin` (second
  mention has quieh), `rochoch` / `cochoch` (B. r'ochoch, c'ochoch).
- `Ma cu xuꜩinic` (B. `Ma cu x-utzitic`): the MS has `xuꜩinic`.
- `Ma cu vꜩ xqui lo` (B. `Mavi utz x-qu lo`): the MS has `macu`.
- `xecha` (plain ch) twice on 0014 beside `xeꜭha` elsewhere: as written.

## Paragraphs
Ximénez indents at `Ta xqui nohih`, `Ta xe vꜭhax chi cut` and `Xeꜭha cu ri Huracan`, with a ¶ at
`Cate cut`; the other breaks follow his full stops at the turns of the story (as the pilot does).
Direct speech nested inside speech (`Qui tiha chic …`) is given without inner quotation marks.
